title: mimid-chat JMAP mode: /allow gets 403, invite numbers shift
description: Seen in the live JMAP test (mimid-1wgh.12.41). (1) /allow in JMAP mode goes to the JSON lane updateConsent and the hub refuses it (403, 'source provider is not a configured peer'); a local KeyMaterial request does not need it, but there is no consent call in JMAP mode at all. (2) 'invite #2 arrived' is a position in the pending list: after invite 1 is joined, the same invite is /join 1, and /join 2 fails. Number invites stably or say the current index.
close_reason: Fixed: stable invite numbers, plain refusal of consent in JMAP mode; tried live on the host (deployed chat-dist/mimid-chat, previous at mimid-chat.prev-jmap1)
